public_rationale: Bloomberg's August 6 report estimates that OpenAI accounted for about 70% of Microsoft's AI revenue during the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, using an estimated annual AI-revenue denominator [e1]. This single-supplier annual estimate cannot establish or refute whether OpenAI and Anthropic together supplied more than 70% of market-wide AI supplier revenue and more than 80% of AI compute sales in April–June 2026 [e1]. The report also does not establish that their purchases created an illusion of broad demand or lacked genuine downstream customers [e1].
limitations: No comparable market-wide numerators and denominators are supplied for either threshold.
The evidence does not independently reproduce the estimated compute-sales share.
Market boundaries, accounting treatment and attribution through intermediaries remain undefined.
Supplier concentration alone does not establish the claimed demand conclusion.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: More than 70% of AI revenues and an estimated 80%+ of compute sales come from OpenAI and Anthropic, creating an illusion of broad AI demand.

statement.excerpt: the reality is that more than 70% of all AI revenues — and I estimate more than 80% of all compute sales — are from Anthropic and OpenAI taking up whatever capacity comes online

from_speaker: more than 70% of all AI revenues
I estimate more than 80% of all compute sales
taking up whatever capacity comes online
creating the illusion of massive demand
our_interpretation: The surrounding supplier discussion makes these customer-attribution claims: revenue earned by suppliers from OpenAI and Anthropic, rather than the laboratories' own sales.
All ordinarily means the relevant market, not one supplier or a selected customer sample.
Use the quarter ended June 30, 2026 as the latest normally reportable completed calendar quarter before the October 6 post. The just-ended September quarter is not substituted using later results.
The 80% figure is explicitly an estimate. The revenue figure supplies no accounting basis, and neither denominator is defined.
Concentration does not by itself establish that the underlying demand is fictitious or lacks downstream customers.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable market-wide data for the target period attributes more than 70% of realized AI supplier revenue and more than 80% of AI compute sales to the two laboratories, with a documented method that avoids double counting.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable market-wide data establishes either share at or below its stated threshold. A smaller share at one supplier alone does not contradict the market-wide claim.
